sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
The grid is still all gray after clicking 4 cells. This is strange. The clicks didn't change anything. Let me think about what's happening.
Wait - the grid was already all gray before I clicked. So I clicked on gray cells, and they should have turned green. But they didn't. Let me check if the coordinates are correct.
Looking at the ascii:
Row 49: GGgggGGgggGGgggGG
- cols 22-23: GG (border)
- cols 24-26: ggg (cell 0,0)
- cols 27-28: GG (border)
- cols 29-31: ggg (cell 0,1)
- cols 32-33: GG (border)
- cols 34-36: ggg (cell 0,2)
- cols 37-38: GG (border)
So all cells are gray. I clicked:
- row 50, col 30 → should be cell (0,1) which is at cols 29-31
- row 55, col 25 → should be cell (1,0) which is at rows 54-56, cols 24-26
- row 55, col 35 → should be cell (1,2) which is at rows 54-56, cols 34-36
- row 60, col 30 → should be cell (2,1) which is at rows 59-61, cols 29-31
But the grid is still all gray. Earlier, when I clicked row 50, col 30 on a white cell, it turned green. And when I clicked row 50, col 25 on a gray cell, it turned green. So the coordinates should be correct.
Wait, maybe the issue is that the grid was reset to all gray by clicking the green cell, and now clicking gray cells doesn't turn them green anymore? Or maybe the "clear all" effect also changed the game state such that clicks no longer work?
Let me try clicking the purple panel to reset to the checkerboard pattern, then click just ONE cell to see if it still works.
